sentences.en: No, no. I mean to say that it has originality.
sentences.zh: 不，不。我的意思是说它有独创性。

sentences.en: Originality is merely a new combination of clichés.
sentences.zh: 独创性只不过是陈词滥调的新组合。

sentences.en: It is better to fail in originality than to succeed in imitation.
sentences.zh: 模仿成功不如独创失败好。

senses.zh: 独创性，创造性,匠心,独到之处,新颖
